issue.title: Persistent artifact viewer pane or mpv IPC instead of spawn-per-open

task_type_fields.proposal:
Today every artifact open spawns a new tmux split and a new Python viewer child, and every `space` press spawns a fresh mpv. Keep a long-lived artifact viewer pane/process instead, or drive mpv through its JSON IPC socket. Later opens, next/previous navigation, and motion starts would then reuse a warm process: no split, interpreter start, or mpv startup per action, and seek/play could resume without a restart. The current launch path lives in src/sase/ace/tui/graphics/_viewer_tmux.py and _viewer_launch.py, with the async split in src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_panel_artifact_open.py. The motion path is _viewer_loop_video.py `_play_motion` / artifact_video_motion_command.

Proposed by phase bead sase-1tb.6 (motion-handoff) note #3 and routed here by the sase-1tb land agent. Background: research:202611/fast_video_artifact_pane/fast_video_artifact_pane.md.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1tb's non-goals exclude persistent-pane and mpv-IPC work ("No persistent-pane or mpv-IPC work"). The plan deferred it so the epic could first remove the per-open launch tax inside the existing spawn-per-open model.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1tb excluded persistent-pane and mpv-IPC work; phase sase-1tb.6 proposed it as a follow-up and the epic lander is routing it to the backlog.
